biggestRisk: The mend()-against-settings coupling across devices. A signed-in child who opens the game offline with a stale cached family-settings copy has custom items stripped by mend(). Their next edit then pushes the stripped save with a matching rev, so the server accepts it. Recovery depends on a grown-up restoring from history. Beyond that, the whole-save 'pick one school' conflict rule may prove too blunt in a family trial and force a merge redesign.
